fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2025-12-03 states that a person allegedly threatened the complainant at Mynthan Colony Main Street and took a bag with documents, on 2025-12-03 around 21:25 hrs. Saravanan Murugan reported the matter orally at Erode North PS; the contact number given was 9000000269. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Ezhilan Rajan, using the number 9000000449. A scooter bearing the number TN-33-YY-1007 was seen leaving the area. Dharani Anand (9000000114) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly intercepted and threatened before valuables were taken.
fields.Keywords: robbery, threat, main street, scooter, suspect, witness, vehicle observation, CCTV
